# Employee handbook

This handbook applies to all permanent staff of Northwind Group. It is reviewed every January by the people team.

## Working hours

The standard week is 38 hours. Core time runs from 10:00 to 15:00, and outside it people organise their day with their team. Overtime is recorded in the time tool and compensated with time off within three months. Work on public holidays is paid at double rate and needs the approval of the department head beforehand.

## Remote work

Up to three days per week are allowed. Requests go to the team lead in the HR portal, and an approval stays valid for six months. The company pays 25 EUR per month towards internet costs, added to the salary automatically. Working from another country is limited to 20 days per year and must be reported to the payroll team in advance.

## Equipment

New joiners receive a laptop, a headset and a second monitor on their first day. A replacement is ordered through the service desk; standard models arrive within five working days. Personal purchases of up to 300 EUR for an ergonomic chair or desk are refunded once every three years against an invoice.

## Training

Each person has a yearly budget of 1 200 EUR and three paid days. Courses longer than a week need a learning agreement: leaving within twelve months after the course means paying back half of the cost. Language lessons are covered in full and do not count against the budget.

## Health and safety

First-aid kits are kept next to every kitchen. Each floor has two trained first aiders, whose names are posted by the lifts. Accidents, even small ones, are reported within 24 hours using the incident form. Fire drills take place twice a year, in April and October.

## Leaving the company

The notice period is one month during probation and three months afterwards. Unused holiday is paid out with the last salary. All equipment is returned to the service desk on the last working day, and access cards stop working at midnight.
documents.IT security policy:
# IT security policy

The policy covers every device and account used for company work, including personal phones that receive company e-mail.

## Passwords

They must have at least 14 characters and are never reused across systems. A password manager is provided to everyone. Changes are forced only after a suspected leak, not on a schedule. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for e-mail, the VPN and the HR portal.

## Laptops

Disks are encrypted before handover, and the screen locks after five minutes without activity. Updates install automatically every Wednesday night; a machine that has missed two updates is blocked from the network until it catches up. Only the service desk may grant administrator rights, for at most 24 hours.

## Lost or stolen devices

Call the security hotline on extension 4444 at once, at any hour. The device is wiped remotely within one hour of the call. Theft must also be reported to the police, and the report number is sent to the service desk within two days.

## E-mail

Messages from outside the company are marked with a yellow banner. Suspicious messages are forwarded to phishing@northwind.example and then deleted. Automatic forwarding to private addresses is blocked. Attachments larger than 25 MB are shared through the company file store instead.

## Software

Only programs from the company software centre may be installed. Anything else needs a request with a business reason and is reviewed by the security team within five working days. Browser extensions are limited to an approved list of twelve.

## Remote access

The VPN connects automatically outside the office. Public Wi-Fi in hotels and airports is allowed only with the VPN on. Sessions end after ten hours and require signing in again.
documents.Office facilities guide:
# Office facilities guide

This guide describes the Berlin head office at Lindenstrasse 12 and the services run by the facilities team.

## Parking

The garage under the building has 60 spaces, booked in the facilities app up to two weeks ahead. Eight spaces with chargers are reserved for electric cars, for at most four hours per day. Guests use the public garage across the street; reception validates their tickets for three hours.

## Kitchen

Coffee, tea, fruit and milk are free. Food left in the fridges is thrown away every Friday at 16:00. Dishwashers are started by whoever fills them last, and the cleaning team empties them in the morning.

## Meeting rooms

Rooms are booked in the calendar; a booking not checked in within 15 minutes is released. The large hall on the ground floor seats 120 and is booked through the facilities team at least five days in advance. Catering for more than ten people is ordered two days ahead.

## Printing

Printers release jobs only after the badge is tapped, so pages never wait in the tray. Colour printing is limited to 200 pages per person per month. Confidential paper goes into the locked grey bins, which are shredded on site every Tuesday.

## Visitors

Guests are registered in the visitor system by noon the day before. They receive a day badge at reception and must be accompanied at all times. Deliveries for employees are kept at the mail room for seven days.

## Cleaning and maintenance

Desks are cleaned every evening if they are empty, so personal items go into the lockers. Broken lights, chairs or blinds are reported in the facilities app and repaired within three working days. The building is closed between 22:00 and 06:00 except for people with night access.
